Development Notices Posted on August 07, 2026

WITHDRAWN

The Planning & Zoning Commission and the City Council of Taylor will be reviewing a request for an Employment Center Plan for property Generally located at 3301 FM 112, legally described as approximately 664.572 acres of land in the H. Pace Survey, Abstract No. 493, more particularly described by the Williamson Central Appraisal District Parcels R006650, R006648, Taylor, Williamson County, Texas

Current Zoning: Extra Territorial Jurisdiction (ETJ)

Proposed Zoning: EC:Employment Center 

Purpose of Request: Employment Center Plan to build a closed campus for data center buildings, substations, gas infrastructure for power generation, and auxiliary buildings

Applicant: Matt Lissak – Kimley-Horn 

Applicant Submittal

PUBLIC HEARINGS WILL BE HELD BY:

Planning and Zoning Commission Public Hearing:

Date: Tuesday, August 18, 2026

Time: 6 P.M.

Location: City Hall Council Chambers, 400 Porter Street, Taylor, TX 76574

City Council Public Hearing

Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026

Time: 6 P.M.

Location: City Hall Council Chambers, 400 Porter Street, Taylor, TX 76574

You may speak for or against the request at either public hearing. If you cannot attend but would like your comments to be heard, please send written comments to the Planning Department before the meeting:

Email: planning@taylortx.gov

Mail: Planning Department, 400 Porter Street, Taylor, TX 76574

Questions? Call us at (512) 352-3675
